title: Kuwait Ministry of Interior Football Team Announces Training for 2026–27 Season
body_markdown:
Training announcement

The Kuwait Ministry of Interior football team has announced that training for the 2026–27 sports season will begin on Sunday, August 2, 2026.

The session is scheduled to start at 6:00 p.m. at Al-Jamarik Stadium.

 Contact details

For inquiries, the announcement lists the following telephone numbers:

- 99779235
- 60600603
excerpt: The Kuwait Ministry of Interior football team will begin preparations for the 2026–27 season at Al-Jamarik Stadium on Sunday, August 2, 2026.

title: Al Salmiya Announce Friendlies for İzmit Training Camp in Turkey
body_markdown:
Al Salmiya have announced three friendly matches as part of their 2026 training camp in İzmit, Turkey.

The Kuwaiti club are scheduled to depart for Turkey on Friday, July 31, before beginning their friendly programme against Egyptian Premier League side ZED FC on August 2.

## Friendly schedule

- **August 2, 2026:** ZED FC (Egypt)
- **August 6, 2026:** Al Markhiya (Qatar)
- **August 10, 2026:** ASO Chlef (Algeria)

Al Markhiya compete in Qatar’s second tier, while ASO Chlef are an Algerian top-flight club.

A possible fourth friendly is listed for August 14, although Al Salmiya have not yet confirmed the opponent.

The team are scheduled to return to Kuwait on Monday, August 17.
excerpt: Al Salmiya will face ZED FC, Al Markhiya and ASO Chlef during their 2026 training camp in İzmit, with a possible fourth friendly yet to be confirmed.

title: Al Qadsia to Face Saudi Side Al Zulfi in Türkiye Friendly
body_markdown:
Al Qadsia SC will continue their pre-season preparations with a friendly match against Saudi Arabian second-tier side Al Zulfi during the club’s training camp in Türkiye.

The match is scheduled to take place on 29 July 2026 at 18:00 local time at Yalova Atatürk Stadium in Yalova, Türkiye.

The fixture will serve as another important test for the Kuwaiti side as they build towards the 2026/27 AFC Challenge League campaign. The coaching staff are expected to use the match to assess the squad’s fitness, tactical progress and match sharpness ahead of the club’s continental commitments.

Al Zulfi, who compete in Saudi Arabia’s second division, will provide competitive opposition in what is expected to be a valuable pre-season encounter for both teams. The friendly is part of Al Qadsia’s preparations before the start of the new competitive season.
excerpt: Kuwaiti club Al Qadsia will face Saudi Arabian second-tier side Al Zulfi in a friendly match in Türkiye as part of their preparations for the upcoming AFC Challenge League campaign.

title: Kuwait FA to Hold 2026–27 Youth Competition Draws
body_markdown:
The Kuwait Football Association will conduct the draws for its youth competitions for the 2026–27 season on Sunday, August 2, 2026.

The event will begin at 7:00 p.m. in the meeting hall at the Kuwait Football Association’s headquarters in Adailiya.

 Competitions included

The draw will cover three age-group leagues:

- Under-19 league
- Under-17 league
- Under-15 league

Sports clubs have been asked to send representatives to attend the draw at the scheduled time and venue.
excerpt: The draws for Kuwait’s Under-15, Under-17 and Under-19 league competitions will take place at 7:00 p.m. on Sunday, August 2, 2026.

title: Kuwaiti Clubs’ Pre-Season Camp Destinations Mapped
body_markdown:
A pre-season map for Kuwaiti football clubs lists four overseas destinations: Turkey, London, Azerbaijan and Egypt.

Turkey

Qadsia, Al Arabi, Kazma and Al Salmiya are scheduled to hold their camps in Turkey, making it the most popular destination alongside Egypt.

 London

Kuwait SC will travel to London for its pre-season camp.

 Azerbaijan

Al Tadamon is the only club listed as holding its camp in Azerbaijan.

 Egypt

Al Nasr, Al Shabab, Al Fahaheel and Al Jahra will conduct their preparations in Egypt.

In total, the map assigns 10 Kuwaiti clubs to overseas pre-season camps across the four destinations.
excerpt: Turkey will host four Kuwaiti clubs, while London, Azerbaijan and Egypt are also listed as pre-season destinations.

title: Al Arabi announce friendly against Pyramids FC in Turkey
body_markdown:
Al Arabi confirm Pyramids friendly

Al Arabi have announced a friendly match against Egyptian club Pyramids FC as part of their training camp in Turkey.

The fixture is scheduled for Tuesday, August 4, 2026, with kick-off set for 4:15pm.

The match will form part of Al Arabi’s preparations during the camp.
excerpt: Al Arabi will face Egyptian side Pyramids FC in a friendly match during the club’s training camp in Turkey.

title: Abdullah Fares joins Al Jazira on loan from Al Arabi
body_markdown:
According to sources, Al Arabi have loaned Abdullah Fares to Al Jazira.

No further details about the loan agreement have been provided.

title: Sources: Two New Private Clubs Set to Join Kuwaiti First Division
body_markdown:
Two clubs set to join

Two new private clubs are set to join the Kuwaiti First Division, according to sources.

The clubs are Go FC, owned by Ali Alhamad, and Al Itihad FC.

 Sponsors and youth programme

Al Itihad FC has announced Boom Al Khaleej and Najd as its sponsors. The club has also started a youth programme.
excerpt: Go FC and Al Itihad FC are expected to join the Kuwaiti First Division, according to sources.
title_ar: مصادر: ناديان خاصان جديدان يستعدان للانضمام إلى دوري الدرجة الأولى الكويتي
excerpt_ar: من المتوقع أن ينضم ناديا غو إف سي والاتحاد إف سي إلى دوري الدرجة الأولى الكويتي، وفقاً لمصادر.
body_markdown_ar:
ناديان يستعدان للانضمام

يستعد ناديان خاصان جديدان للانضمام إلى دوري الدرجة الأولى الكويتي، وفقاً لمصادر.

والناديان هما غو إف سي، المملوك لعلي الحمد، والاتحاد إف سي.

 الرعاة وبرنامج الناشئين

أعلن نادي الاتحاد إف سي عن بوم الخليج ونجد بصفتهما راعيين له. كما أطلق النادي برنامجاً للناشئين.
